**Login:** `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts:16`) is a local, name-only account — no server auth. It loads `localStorage["ai_dnd_user_<lowercase name>"]` or creates an empty `UserProfile`, then saves it as the active profile under `ai_dnd_user`. `authGuard` just checks `isLoggedIn()` (`profile() !== null`).

**Campaigns stored:** Entirely client-side, in `localStorage`, as `CampaignSlot`s on the `UserProfile` (keys `ai_dnd_user` and `ai_dnd_user_<name>`), managed by `addCampaign`/`updateCampaign`/`removeCampaign` (`auth.service.ts:36,44,54`). Each slot holds a `sessionId` + `characterId` pointing to server state — Workers KV `session:<sessionId>` (7‑day TTL, `services/session.ts`) and D1 tables `characters`, `character_inventory`, `adventure_log`.

**On deleting a slot:** `removeCampaign` only removes the local slot/pointer — it does **not** delete anything server-side. The D1 character row, inventory, adventure log, and (until TTL expiry) the KV session all remain; the browser simply loses the link to them.
